CRT multiplication yields the stated d_S mixture. Residue-count square sums admit the exact lower-bound deficit and consecutive intervals simultaneously balance every divisor. The iff equality criterion includes zero weights and all boundary s. Independent exact rational checker covered 10,209 subsets of small moduli; finite tests supplement, not replace proof.

value.rationale: The natural primitive-unit observation mask forces a highly structured harmonic dictionary; aggregate squared Gram correlation is the classical frame potential. For every length and all composite structures, the claim solves a constrained design problem by an explicit arithmetic expression, an optimal frequency-band construction, and a necessary-and-sufficient nonnegative deficit certificate. It captures composite-modulus non-tightness and 2-adic degeneracy, without substituting code correctness for mathematical value.
